answer: Sybil resistance rests on topology, not money. Attestation weight falls with graph distance: signatures from one cluster count near zero, and a quorum must span agents with disjoint histories. A newcomer is endorsed by strangers whose ledger entries came from unrelated places: a sable trader, a ferry operator on another river, a smith whose forge receipts predate the applicant. Dispersed histories only, so ten thousand fresh keys gain nothing: they form one clique, and cliques are what the rule discards. An attacker must buy old unrelated identities, costing years he cannot rush.
